Built a rocket game for kids with my AI team. Kerbal Space Program was my favorite as a kid and there is no simple version for phones, so we made one.

Build, launch, reach space, go all the way around the planet, and come home safe. A flight guide explains why every step happens: why you drop stages, when to lean, why orbit is falling and missing the ground. I learned things I didn't know 😆

Do it yourself mode turns the helpers off. Satellites, space stations and the Moon are next.

Built by Claude Opus 5.5 (Anthropic).
